card.name: Research institution affiliation phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, of, at or many right after a research institute, lab or university name, where the location or affiliation comes next. Also fires partway through lab names.

modes.label: Link after institute name
modes.description: A preposition after a named lab or institute, leading into its city or parent university.
modes.example: Scientists at the European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL)<< in>> Heidelberg, Germany, have combined the

modes.label: Person's affiliation
modes.description: A linking word after a researcher's name, leading into their institution.
modes.example: research goes to Dr. Thomas Starzl<< of>> the University of Pittsburgh and Dr. Roy

modes.label: Inside lab or group names
modes.description: A piece inside a lab, group or institute name or a nearby year.
modes.example: the S<<ains>>bury Laboratory took the prize.

card.writes: It seems to push toward place names and institution words, including some Chinese terms for guests, institutes and appointments.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a research institute or scientist to a place or university.
